page_title: EMP 0-2 JUV | Empoli v Juventus 03/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' A yellow card for a tackle by Mattia Destro (Empoli). Giovanni Ayroldi doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Moise Kean (Juventus) has a sight of goal and fires from the edge of the box, but his strike rattles the left post!
90+4' Unlucky! A great strike from Mattia Destro (Empoli) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
90+2' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
90+1' Juventus can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
86' Giovanni Ayroldi shows a yellow card to Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) for a tough tackle.
84' Federico Chiesa comes off the pitch to be replaced by Moise Kean (Juventus).
83' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to make a change. Timothy Weah (Juventus) replaces Weston McKennie.
83' Substitution. Nicolo Cambiaghi is replaced by Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli).

82' 0 - 2 Federico Chiesa (Juventus) weaves his way past several defenders and finds himself in a one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy throws the keeper off balance and he simply puts the ball into the back of net.
79' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
78' The ball is cleared after Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Good work from Juventus as they win a corner.
75' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
74' Paul Pogba (Juventus) is penalised for a foul. Giovanni Ayroldi had a clear view and blows his whistle.
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Francesco Caputo as he is replaced by Mattia Destro (Empoli).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) replaces Razvan Marin.
71' Massimiliano Allegri decides to make a substitution. Filip Kostic will be replaced by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
71' Substitution. Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Dusan Vlahovic walks off.
71' The referee blows for a cooling break.
70' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.

68' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
66' Paul Pogba (Juventus) has a goal ruled out for offside!
65' Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mattia Perin intercepts the ball.

64' Francesco Caputo (Empoli) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
63' Razvan Marin (Empoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The linesman signals a throw-in for Empoli.
62' Substitution. Fabio Miretti did his best and is replaced by Paul Pogba (Juventus).
61' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Tommaso Baldanzi is replaced by Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli).
61' Substitution. Jacopo Fazzini walks off the pitch and Alberto Grassi (Empoli) comes on as a substitute.

60' The cross into the penalty area from Weston McKennie (Juventus) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.

59' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
56' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Federico Chiesa (Juventus) but poses no threat.
56' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Fabio Miretti (Juventus).
55' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.

52' A rebound falls to Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Empoli.
50' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Empoli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
49' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Giovanni Ayroldi didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
48' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Giovanni Ayroldi ignores the protests.
48' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle as Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Razvan Marin (Empoli) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Giovanni Ayroldi shows the yellow card to Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) for a heavy challenge.
43' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle for a foul after Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) hacks down one of his opponents.
41' The ball goes behind for a corner. Empoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom left corner, but Etrit Berisha pulls off a superb save.
39' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

37' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. PENALTY to Juventus! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.

35' Filip Kostic (Juventus) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Etrit Berisha!
34' Danilo (Juventus) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Giovanni Ayroldi stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.

32' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) attempts to score from a difficult angle on the edge of the box, but sends his effort narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
31' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Weston McKennie (Juventus) inside the box.
30' A lofted cross from Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
29' The game is interrupted as Francesco Caputo (Empoli) is flagged offside.
26' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
24' 0 - 1 Goal! Danilo (Juventus) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
24' Filip Kostic (Juventus) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
23' Filip Kostic (Juventus) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
20' Empoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

17' Adrien Rabiot plays a hopeful lofted pass into the box. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) luckily gets his head to the ball and sends it narrowly wide of the right post from near the penalty spot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Empoli.
17' The resulting corner from Fabio Miretti (Juventus) comes to nothing.
16' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Juventus.
15' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) has received a yellow card for his foul.
15' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
11' Giovanni Ayroldi blows his whistle and it's Danilo (Juventus) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
10' Filip Kostic (Juventus) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
10' Filip Kostic (Juventus) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Juventus.
9' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) jumps into a tackle and Giovanni Ayroldi signals a foul.
8' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.

7' A sweeping move ends with a pass to Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) inside the box. He lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but Etrit Berisha was watching it all the way and makes a comfortable save.

7' Weston McKennie (Juventus) connects with a cross from the side and steers a header from around the penalty spot towards the goal. The ball goes in the right direction, but it's stopped by one of the defenders.
5' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
5' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but Mattia Perin comes off his line to gather the ball.
5' Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
4' Referee Giovanni Ayroldi sees the trip by Fabio Miretti (Juventus) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
3' Weston McKennie (Juventus) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. It's a throw-in for Juventus.
2' Fabio Miretti (Juventus) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Adrien Rabiot (Juventus). Juventus have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Empoli will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Giovanni Ayroldi.
